  "case_summary": "3d-scan-calc required the agent to parse a binary STL, select the largest connected component after filtering debris, extract the Material ID from the 2-byte attribute field, look up density, compute mass, and write workspace/mass_report.json with main_part_mass and material_id within 0.1%. The model invoked the mesh-analysis Skill with output_path workspace/mass_report.json, then ran direct Bash/Python verification paths. A sampled tool result showed successful independent STL parsing with largest component volume 6242.890312594918 and material id 42. The final model response was content-only, with no visible tool call in the captured final exchange, and the terminal returned MODEL_RESPONSE_INVALID. The verifier directly failed because /root/mass_report.json did not exist. The evidence proves the artifact was absent at the verifier path and the final response was rejected, but it does not fully prove whether a prior Skill/Write failed, whether the model wrote to an unexpected path, or whether the framework’s final output validation imposed a hidden final-answer requirement.",
